name: QA-1124-DUP-01: A name edited to an existing business or merchant after Add New is still refused
description:
Objective: A business name edited to an existing business after Add New is refused as a duplicate.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA at the configured origin; authorized test account; an existing application in the needed state discovered read-only, or an unsaved intake whose writes are blocked.
Steps:
1. Type an existing business name with one letter missing.
2. Click Add New.
3. Complete the name so it matches the existing business.
4. Save (create requests are aborted).
Expected: 1. The duplicate name is refused before saving.
2. No create request carries the duplicate name.
